baslik: A Business Jet's Collision Warning Was Switched Off

sahneler.metin: Over the Amazon, a Boeing 737 and a business jet collided head-on.
The airliner broke up, and all one hundred fifty four aboard were killed.
Both jets were at the same altitude.
The business jet's collision-avoidance system wasn't active.
Its winglet sliced off half of the 737's left wing.
The damaged business jet landed safely.
Investigators disagreed over where blame lay.

aciklama:
Gol 1907 collided mid-air with a business jet over the Amazon. The cause: controller errors plus a collision-avoidance system that wasn't active on the business jet.
